he has come to his people and set them frée.
He has raised up for us a míghty saviour,
born of the house of his servant David.
Through his holy prophets he promised of old
that he would save us from our enemies,
from the hands of all who hate us.
He promised to show mercy to our fathers
and to remember his holy covenant.
This was the oath he swore to our father Abraham:
to set us free from the hands of our enemies:
free to worship hím without fear,
holy and righteous in his sight all the days of our life.
You, my child, shall be called the prophet of the Most High,
for you will go before the Lord to prepare his way.
to give his people knowledge of salvation
by the forgiveness of their síns.
In the tender compassion of our God
the dawn from on high shall break upón us,
to shine on those who dwell in darkness and the shadow of death,
and to guide our feet into the way of peace.

Let us praise the Lord, the God of Israel,
for he came to the help of his people and set them free.
He raised up a mighty Saviour for us,
one who is a descendant of his servant David.
This is what he said long ago by means of his holy prophets:
He promised to save us from our enemies/
and from the power of all those who hate us.
He said he would show mercy to our ancestors,
and remember his sacred covenant.
He made a solemn promise to our ancestor Abraham,
and vowed that he would rescue us from our enemies/
and allow us to serve him without fear,
to be holy and righteous before him,
all the days of our life.
You, my child, will be called a prophet of the Most High God;
you will go ahead of the Lord to prepare his road for him,
to tell his people that they will be saved,
by having their sins forgiven.
For our God is merciful and tender;
he will cause the bright dawn of salvation to rise on us,
and shine from heaven on all those who live in the dark shadow of death,
to guide our steps into the path of peace.

paras.t: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel,
for he has visited his people, he has come to their rescue.
And he has raised up for us a power for salvation
in the house of his servant Davíd,
even as he proclaimed

Thus he shows mercy to our ancestors,
thus he remembers his holy covenant*
the oath he swore to our father Abraham:
that he would grant us free from fear *
to be delivered from the hands of our enemies,
to serve him in holiness and virtue in his presence all our days.
And you, little child, you shall be called Prophet of the Most High
for you will go before the Lord to prepare the way for him,
to give his people knowledge of salvation
through the forgiveness of their sins;

to give light to those who live in darkness and the shadow of death,
and to guide our feet into the way of peace.
Praise the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit
both now and forever. Amen.

blocks.caption: As engraved in the book — setting 7

paras.t: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel.
He has visited his people and redeemed them.
He has raised up for us a mighty saviour
in the house of David his servant,
as he promised by the lips of holy men,
those who were his prophets from of old:
a saviour who would free us from our foes,
from the hands of all who hate us.
So his love for our fathers is fulfilled
and his holy covenant remembered.
He swore to Abraham our father *
to grant us that free from fear,
and saved from the hands of our foes,
we might serve him in holiness and justice
all the days of our life in his presence,
As for you, little child, you shall be called
a prophet of God, the Most High.
You shall go ahead of the Lord
to prepare his ways before him,
to make known to his people their salvation,
through forgiveness of all their sins,
the loving-kindness of the heart of our God
who visits us like the dawn from on high. *
He will give light to those in darkness,
those who dwell in the shadow of death,
and guide us into the way of peace.
Praise the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit
both now and forever. Amen.

My soul proclaims the greatness of the Lord,
my spirit rejoices in God my Saviour;
for he has looked with favour on his lowly servant
and from this day all generations will call me blessed.
The Almighty has done great things for me:/
holy is his name.
He has mercy on those who fear him in every generation.
He has shown the strength of his arm,
he has scattered the proud in their conceit.
He has cast down the mighty from their thrones,
and has lifted up the lowly.
He has filled the hungry with good things,
and sent the rich away empty-handed.
He has come to the help of his servant Israel,
for he remembered his promise of mercy,
the promise he made to our fathers,
to Abraham and his children forever.
Glory to the Father and to the Són
and to the Holy Spirit,
as in the beginning, sò nów
and forever. Amen.

O praise, my soul, the Lord;
O glorify his name.
In him my spirit thrills with joy,
my Saviour and my God.
From heav'n he gazed on me,
his lowly servant-maid.
Behold, all ages yet to come
shall call me blest of God.
The Lord's wondrous power
has done great things for me.
Forever blessed be his name,
who is the Holy One.
His mercy he reveals
to those who fear his name.
From age to age his steadfast love
shall endlessly endure.
His arm is strong to save;
he scatters all the proud.
He casts the mighty from their thrones;
he raises up the meek.
He fills the hungry poor
with blessings from above.
The rich he strips of wealth and power
and empty sends away.
His mighty hand has grasped
the hand of Israel,
his servant-son beloved by him,
with never failing love.
Now is his promise kept,
once made to Abraham,
that in his seed should man be blest
for all eternity.
O Father, fount of joy,
your glory I adore.
O loving Spirit, praise be yours,
who gave me God, my son.
My soul, now glorify
the Lord who is my Saviour.
Rejoice, for who am I
that God has shown me favour
The world shall call me blest
and ponder on my story.
In me is manifest
God's greatness and his glory.
For those who are his friends
and keep his law as holy
his mercy never ends,
and he exalts the lowly.
But by his power the great,
the proud, the self-conceited,
the kings who sit in state
are humbled and defeated.
He feeds the starving poor,
he guards his holy nation,
fulfilling what he swore
long since in revelation.
Then glorify with me
the Lord who is my Saviour:
one holy Trinity
forever and forever.
My soul proclaims the greatness of the Lord,

because he has looked upon his lowly handmaid.

for the Almighty has done great things for me.

for those who fear him.

and exalted the lowly.
The hungry he has filled with good things,
and sent the rich away empty.
He has come to the help of Israel his servant,
mindful of his mercy
according to the promise he made to our ancestors
of his mercy to Abraham and to his descendants forever.
Praise the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit
both now and forever. Amen.
My soul now glorifies: the Lord my God
My spirit sings his praise: the Lord my God
Rejoice for who am I, from now all ages
Will call me blessed: the Lord my God
Most holy is his name: the Lord my God
His gifts he has outpoured: the Lord my God
In me is manifest, God's greatness and his glory
I magnify the Lord: the Lord my God
His mercy forever: the Lord my God
For those who keep his laws: the Lord my God
He puts his arm in strength, and down he brought the proud
He exalts the lowly: the Lord my God
He fills the starving poor: the Lord my God
And sends the rich away: the Lord my God
Fulfilling his promise, to father Abraham
In ages long ago: the Lord my God
Glorify the Father: the Lord my God
And Jesus Christ his Son: the Lord my God
And praise the Spirit, with them in unity
Now and forever more: the Lord my God.

strophes.t: Come, let us praise the Lord!
Let us sing for joy to our protector and Saviour!
Let us come before him with thanksgiving
and sing joyful songs of praise!
For the Lord is a mighty God,
a mighty king over all the gods.
He rules over the whole earth,
from the deepest caves to the highest hills.
He rules over the sea, which he made;
the land also, which he himself formed.
Come, let us bow down and worship him;
let us kneel before the Lord, our Maker!
He is our God;
we are the people he looks after,
the flock for which he provides.
Listen today to what he says:
“Don't be stubborn, as your ancestors were at Meribah,
as they were that day in the desert at Massah,
There they put me to the test and tried me,
although they had seen what I did for them.
For forty years I was disgusted with those people;
I said, >How disloyal they are!
They refuse to obey my commands!’
I was angry and made a solemn promise,
>You will never enter the land where I would
give you rest.’

items.label: Sun.1 & 3
items.text: Come, let us praise the Lord! Let us sing to God who protects us. Halleluia!

items.label: Mon.1 & 3
items.text: Let us come before the Lord, giving thanks.

items.label: Tue.1 & 3
items.text: The Lord is a great king: come, let us adore him.

items.label: Wed.1 & 3
items.text: Let us adore the Lord, for it is he who made us.

items.label: Thu.1 & 3
items.text: Come, let us adore the Lord, for He is our God.

items.label: Fri.1 & 3
items.text: Give thanks to the Lord, for his great love is without end.

items.label: Sat.1 & 3
items.text: The Lord's is the earth and its fullness: come, let us adore him.

items.label: Sun.2 & 4
items.text: We are the people of God, the flock for which he provides. Let us adore him, Halleluia!

items.label: Mon.2 & 4
items.text: Let us rejoice in the Lord; with songs let us praise him.

items.label: Tue.2 & 4
items.text: A mighty God is the Lord: come, let us adore him.

items.label: Wed.2 & 4
items.text: Cry out with joy to God, all the earth: serve the Lord with gladness.

items.label: Thu.2 & 4
items.text: Come before the Lord, singing for joy.

items.label: Fri.2 & 4
items.text: Indeed, how good is the Lord; bless his holy name.

items.label: Sat.2 & 4
items.text: Let us listen for the voice of the Lord and enter into his peace.

items.label: Advent
items.text: Come, let us worship the Lord, the King who is to come.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: The Lord is at hand: come, let us adore him.

items.label: 24 December
items.text: Know today that the Lord will come: in the morning you will see his glory.

items.label: Christmas (Before Epiphany)
items.text: Christ is born for us; come, let us adore him.

items.label: Christmas (After Epiphany)
items.text: Christ has appeared to us; come, let us adore him. Holy Family: Come, let us worship Christ, the Son of God, who was obedient to Mary and Joseph. Mary Mother of God: Let us celebrate the motherhood of the Virgin Mary; let us worship her Son, Christ the Lord.

items.label: Epiphany
items.text: Christ has appeared to us; come, let us adore him. Baptism of the Lord: Come, let us worship Christ the beloved Son in whom the Father was well pleased.

items.label: Lent
items.text: Come, let us worship Christ the Lord, who for our sake endured temptation and suffering.

items.label: or
items.text: Today if you hear the voice of the Lord, harden not your hearts. Holy week: Come, let us worship Christ the Lord, who for our sake endured temptation and suffering. Good Friday: Come, let us worship Christ, the Son of God, who redeemed us with his blood. Holy Saturday: Come, let us worship Christ, who for our sake suffered death and was buried.

items.label: Easter (to the Ascension)
items.text: The Lord is risen. Halleluia! Ascension: Hallelulia! Come, let us worship Christ the Lord as he ascends into heaven. Halleluia! After Ascension: Come, let us adore Christ the Lord who promised to send the Holy Spirit on his people. Halleluia! Pentecost: Halleluia! The Spirit of the Lord has filled the whole world; come let us worship him. Halleluia! Trinity: Come, let us worship the true God: One in Trinity, Trinity in One. Body and Blood of Christ: Come, let us adore Christ the Lord, the bread of life. Sacred Heart: Come, let us worship Jesus, whose heart was wounded for love of us. All Saints: Come, let us worship God whose praises are sung in the assembly of the saints. All Souls: Come, let us worship the Lord; all things live for him. Christ the King: Come, let us worship Jesus Christ, the King of kings.

paras.t: Some Antiphons For Midday:

items.label: Before Noon
items.text: The prophets foretold that the Saviour would be born of the Virgin Mary.

items.label: Midday
items.text: The angel Gabriel said to Mary, `Rejoice, most highly favoured one! The Lord is with you. Of all women, you are the most blessed'.

items.label: Afternoon
items.text: Mary was greatly troubled at this greeting and wondered what it might mean. She said, `I am to give birth to a King without ceasing to be a virgin'.

items.label: Before Noon
items.text: Joseph and Mary, the mother of Jesus, wondered at what was being said about him.

items.label: Midday
items.text: Mary treasured all these things and pondered them in her heart.

items.label: Afternoon
items.text: My eyes have seen the salvation which you prepared in the presence of all the peoples.

items.label: Before Noon
items.text: The mystery, which was hidden from earlier ages and generations, is now made clear.

items.label: Midday
items.text: Christ came and preached peace to you who were far off, and peace to you who were near.

items.label: Afternoon
items.text: I have appointed you to be a light to all peoples, to be my saving power to the very ends of the earth.

items.label: Before Noon
items.text: This is the time of repentance for us to atone for our sins and seek salvation.

items.label: Midday
items.text: As I live, says the Lord, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked man, rather let him turn from his evil way and live.

items.label: Afternoon
items.text: Armed with the justice which is the power of God, let us prove ourselves with great patience.

items.label: Antiphon
items.text: Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

paras.t: 1. O Holy Spirit, ever one
with both the Father and the Son,
come now, O God, and spread, we pray,
your presence in our hearts today.
Let flesh and heart and lips and mind
sound forth our witness to mankind,
and love light up our mortal frame
till others catch the living flame.
Dear Father, grant us what we ask
through Jesus Christ, your Word of love,
whose Spirit makes us ever praise
one God, the king of all the world.
2. O mighty Ruler, faithful God,
you guide the day and all it brings
from dawn's bright splendour fresh with hope
to noontime's trying heat and sweat.
Put out the flames of angry strife,
remove the heat of wrong desire,
restore our bodies' health and strength
and guard our hearts in lasting peace.
Dear Father, grant us what we ask
through Jesus Christ, your Word of love,
whose Spirit makes us ever praise
one God, the king of all the world.
3. O God, creation's mighty force,
the master of all passing things,
you make all things result in good
for those who love and trust in you.
As day recedes, please give us light
to keep our life from fading out;
let love keep driving us in hope
till death brings glory without end.
Dear Father, grant us what we ask
through Jesus Christ, your Word of love,
whose Spirit makes us ever praise
one God, the king of all the world.

items.label: Lent, Sunday I
items.text: Now we are going up to Jerusalem, and everything that is written about the Son of Man will come true.

items.label: Lent, Sunday 2
items.text: God did not spare his own Son but gave him up for us all.

items.label: Lent, Sunday 3
items.text: Ours were the sufferings he bore, ours the sorrows he carried.

items.label: Lent, Sunday 4
items.text: God fulfilled what he had foretold in the words of all the prophets: that Christ would suffer.

items.label: Lent, Sunday 5
items.text: He was wounded for our faults, he was bruised for our sins. Through his wounds we are healed.

items.label: Lent, Palm Sunday
items.text: He carried our sins in his own body on the cross, so that we might die to sin and live for holiness.

strophes.t: Christ himself suffered for you
and left you an example,
so that you would follow in his steps.
He committed no sin;
no one ever heard a lie come from his lips.
When he was cursed
he did not answer back with a curse.
When he suffered he did not threaten,
but placed his hopes in God,
the righteous Judge.
Christ himself carried our sins
on his body to the cross,
so that we might die to sin
and live for righteousness.
By his wounds
you have been healed.
You were like sheep that had lost their way ;
but now you have been brought back
to follow the Shepherd and Keeper of your souls.
